title: Raysut Cement renews distribution agreement with Barwaaqo Cement
summary: Raysut Cement renews distribution agreement with Barwaaqo Cement
body_markdown: **Oman/Somalia:** Raysut Cement has renewed its distribution agreement with Barwaaqo Cement in Somalia, for an estimated value of US$49m. The agreement is reportedly expected to contribute to improved production capacity and increased financial returns. It is valid from 15 September 2026 to 14 September 2027. The two companies signed a similar agreement on 9 November 2025, which was valid until 14 September 2026.
